resources.string: The data on this device can\'t be read

TeamCraft\'s encrypted data on this device is damaged, or the key that opens it is gone. Your messages are not lost: set this device up again and unlock your keys with your recovery passphrase, or link it from another device. The old data is kept aside, not deleted.
This data is from a newer TeamCraft
A newer version of TeamCraft changed the data on this device, and this version can\'t read it. Update TeamCraft to the newest version, then try again.
TeamCraft keeps the unreadable data beside the new data, so nothing is deleted, but this device starts empty and fills again from the server once you unlocked your keys.
